summary: Java uses + - * / % for arithmetic. When both values are ints, / gives an int and drops the decimal.
notes: 7 / 2 is 3 because both values are ints. 7.0 / 2 is 3.5.
% gives the remainder. n % 2 == 0 means n is even.
Math.pow(2, 3) returns the double 8.0. Java has no ** operator.
pitfall: Dividing two ints for an average drops the decimal with no error. Divide by 3.0 or cast with (double).
